rows.title: The rule is restated exactly
rows.defect: the reply drops what the merchant counted as before
rows.test: the reply names the old category it leaves

rows.title: The ways people say it
rows.defect: the isn't-it's form is not read, so the first category named wins
rows.test: 'target isn't shopping, it's groceries' is a rule for groceries

rows.title: A money move is not a rule
rows.defect: the savings, account and budget words are no longer kept out, so a budget is answered as an unknown category
rows.test: 'categorize target under my budget' goes on

rows.title: A statement is not a rule
rows.defect: any subject of 'is' is taken as a merchant
rows.test: 'my biggest expense is groceries' goes on

rows.title: Subscriptions stay with the cancel flow
rows.defect: the subscriptions exclusion is dropped, so a likely cancel is answered as a category rule
rows.test: 'remove netflix from my subscriptions' goes on

rows.title: No pronoun as a merchant
rows.defect: the pronoun check is dropped, so a rule for the word "that" is saved
rows.test: 'recategorize that as groceries' saves nothing

rows.title: Food is asked, never guessed
rows.defect: food is taken as groceries
rows.test: 'count Target as food' asks which

rows.title: No rule for a bank word
rows.defect: the generic-word check is dropped
rows.test: 'count payment as shopping' saves nothing

rows.title: Already there is said, not saved
rows.defect: a rule repeating the default is saved
rows.test: 'count Kroger as groceries' saves nothing

rows.title: One rule per merchant
rows.defect: the old rule stays beside the new one
rows.test: a second Target rule replaces the first

rows.title: Stop removes only the matching rule
rows.defect: the category in a stop is not checked
rows.test: 'stop counting Target as restaurants' changes nothing

rows.title: Out of a category is a stop
rows.defect: the out-of form is not read
rows.test: 'take target out of groceries' removes the rule

rows.title: Someone else's rule goes on
rows.defect: a rule we don't have is answered as ours
rows.test: 'delete my autosave rule' is not ours

rows.title: Clear all clears all
rows.defect: only the first rule is removed
rows.test: delete all my category rules leaves none

rows.title: At most 40
rows.defect: the limit is not checked
rows.test: a 41st rule is refused

rows.title: Storable: no long digit runs
rows.defect: the id carries the raw millisecond time
rows.test: the id is base 36

rows.title: No number for a name
rows.defect: the digits check is dropped
rows.test: a 5-digit run is refused

rows.title: Whole words only
rows.defect: the term matches inside another word
rows.test: a Target rule leaves TARGETED ADS alone

rows.title: The longest rule wins
rows.defect: the first matching rule wins
rows.test: joes corner store beats joes

rows.title: A more specific merchant keeps its category
rows.defect: the rule wins over a more specific known merchant
rows.test: a Costco rule leaves Costco Gas as gas

rows.title: The spending answer counts by the rules
rows.defect: the spending answer ignores the rules
rows.test: groceries is $245.50 with the Target rule

rows.title: The answer says a rule moved money
rows.defect: the rule line is never said
rows.test: 'By your category rule: "Target" as groceries $165.50.'

rows.title: Budgets count by the rules
rows.defect: the budget ignores the rules
rows.test: the groceries budget is at $225.50

rows.title: A bad stored rule is ignored
rows.defect: any stored group is trusted
rows.test: a rule for 'pets' changes nothing

rows.title: The comparison counts by the rules
rows.defect: the comparison ignores the rules it is given
rows.test: groceries is $225.50 with the rule and $80.00 without
